units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 8:1">Tosef. Sot. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בכל יום … נוֹסֵעַ אחר וכ׳</he> every day the ark moved behind two standards (divisions), …, but on that day it moved in front; <cite ref="Sotah 33b:11">Sot. 33ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:10">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>לאחר שהיו נוֹסְעִים … נוסעים את המשכן</he> after these two standards had moved, the Levites marched (carrying) the Tabernacle.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 686:1">Yalk. ib. 686</cite> <he>מתקרבים לִיסַּע</he> came together to make ready for the march. Mekh. B’shall., Vayass’a, s. 1 <he>זו נסיעה לא נָסְעוּ וכ׳</he> this march they undertook by the order of Moses, but all other marches they made at the order of the Deity, a. fr.

senses.gloss: to remove, cause to depart, to separate, take apart. Mekh. l. c. הִסִּיעָן בעל כרחן במקל he forced them to march, against their will, with the staff. Ib. ע״ז עברה … והִסִּיעָהּ משה וכ׳ an idol went with the Israelites across the sea, and Moses removed it &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:7">Kel. V, 7</cite> <he>צריך להַסִּיעוֹ</he> he must (not only divide, but) separate the parts of the stove entirely.

<cite ref="Sotah 8a:1">Sot. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בית דין מַסִּיעִין את העדים וכ׳</he> the court orders the witnesses to change their places; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 9:1">Tosef. Snh. IX, 1</cite> (ed. Zuck. <he>מַשִּׂיאִין</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:7">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 11:2">Gen. XI, 2</cite>) <he>הִסִּיעוּ עצמן מקדמונו וכ׳</he> they removed themselves from the Originator of the world; <cite ref="Genesis 11:2">ib.</cite> s. 41 <he>ה׳ עצמו וכ׳</he> he removed himself &c. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 10 <he>גפן שהִסַּעְתָּה ממצרים</he> the vine (Israel) which thou didst transfer from Egypt (<cite ref="Psalms 80:9">Ps. LXXX, 9</cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:8">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>להַסִּיעַ על קיצתן</he> to remove (place outside of the protection of the law, Rashi) those who disregard the terms fixed by the authorities.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:5">Erub. VIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 86a">86ᵃ</cite>) <he>הסעי מלבו</he> (Ms. M. <he>הסירה</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>הסיחה מדעתו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he has removed from his mind (the thought of returning to his residence). Mekh. B’shall. s. 3 (ref. to <he>ויסעו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 14:15">Ex. XIV, 15</cite>) <he>יַסִּיעוּ דברים</he> (<he>שהיו דוברים</he>) <cite ref="M01482"><he>מלבן</he></cite> let them remove from their hearts the (evil) words which &c.; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:5">Ex. R. s. 21</cite>.—<he>ה׳ דעת</he> = <he>הסיח דעת</he>, v. <cite ref="N00923"><he>נָסַח</he></cite>. Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ bot.; a. fr.—[Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ <he>מפני מסיע</he>, read: <cite ref="E00707"><he>הֶסֵּיעַ</he></cite>.—
Tosef. Shebi. II, 20 מסיעין, read מְסַיְּיעִין.]—2) to signalize, v. נָשָׂא.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:4">Tosef. Yoma I, 4</cite> <he>ה׳ מן הכהונה</he> was removed (deposed) from the high priesthood; Y. Hor. III, 47ᵈ top.
